Class SecurityPositionSeries

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.SecurityPositionSeries
public final class SecurityPositionSeries extends Object
Builds the holding phases of one security in one scope and the series of the security position chart for one of them. The input comes from the transaction replay of every security account of the scope, walked in the currency of the security, and from the daily values of the holding rows. The class is a pure function of its input; it reads no repository and holds no state, which is what lets every case be fixed with hand-calculated numbers.
  • A phase starts on the first business date whose end-of-day units, summed over the accounts, are not flat after a flat day, and ends on the next flat day. Income booked after the end of a phase and before the next one belongs to the ended phase.
  • A point is a valued day of the phase, plus the closing day of a closed phase with value 0. A day with units but without a usable value is left out; it sets NOT_VALUED_DAYS only when the stock exchange of the security had a session that day before today.
  • An event belongs to the first point on or after its date. Events after the last point stay in the event list but not in the series.
  • invested is the sum of the cost bases the replay keeps per account. Its main currency counterpart converts each purchase with its own rate and removes the same historical amount on a sale, so the realized result in main currency contains the currency result on the cost.
  • Flows are kept gross for the drawdown; only the two legs of one security transfer on one point are netted.
